title: 1974: clarinet on the Albert system
summary: He had cornet, clarinet and sax together, and the Italians taught him the Albert system clarinet.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: What about then, since you were playing cornet, were you playing clarinet and saxophone at the same time?
You had them all there together.
I had them all together. And I had a clarinet. I wasn't using a Boehm system clarinet. I was using the Albert system. And that made a difference.
Was that because Albert -- it was named after the man, right?
No, Italians -- yeah, it was named after a man, yeah. Those Italians, they taught me to play the Albert system. They didn't know nothing about the Boehm system.
It's a funny thing about music, if you've got music in your soul and your heart it don't make any difference what you're doing or who you are, you just -- it's going to come out some kind of way.
So I got fired off of that job real quick.
